subject: reasoning
question:
Identify the figure given in the options which when put in place of ? will logically complete the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04d43976d1f9176b3a8efd2868bec8e69fe2638eb502ea3e2c1ba08459bb807e.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Letters are shifting in clockwise direction starting from middle letter to bottom-left corner.

Bottom-left letter is removed and a new letter is added in middle position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd5c1062b1222e2efeb82f620b67d1930e1e41fb9815feb870a8c7c045ed3278.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
